LESSON: PARABLE ON PRAYER MIDNIGHT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life and Ministry of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.3: Parable on prayer Midnight

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Parable on prayer Midnight. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how they pray daily. 1. Why should Christians pray at all times?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life
2. appreciate the parable by praying to God always

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: PARABLE ON PRAYER MIDNIGHT
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 9
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Parable on prayer Midnight helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: PARABLE ON PRAYER MIDNIGHT
Study Parable on prayer Midnight like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life

What this means
In this part you learn to apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Parable on prayer Midnight” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the parable by praying to God always

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the parable by praying to God always. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the parable by praying to God always.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Parable on prayer Midnight in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the parable by praying to God always. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Parable on prayer Midnight is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Parable on prayer Midnight” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Parable on prayer Midnight in your own words. (skill: appreciate the parable by praying to God always)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Parable on prayer Midnight to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the parable by praying to God always.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Parable on prayer Midnight from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Parable on prayer Midnight: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Parable on prayer Midnight?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how they pray daily. 1. Why should Christians pray at all times?
2. How do you exercise faith in God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Parable on prayer Midnight means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life.
5. Be able to: appreciate the parable by praying to God always.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
